entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Get me a person, now! This is ridiculous.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, you can help me by taking back this garbage jersey you sent me. I want a refund, and I want it yesterday.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To pull up your account, could I get your order number please?
It's VF-8675309. And don't just 'look into it.' Fix it. This thing is a joke.
Thank you, I have your order for the ProFit Jersey right here. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? It's the wrong size! Your sizing chart is completely off. This jersey is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. Are you selling clothes for dolls? This is false advertising!
I understand your frustration completely. It's definitely disappointing when an item doesn't fit the way you expect. I see you received it just three days ago.
That's right! And I want my money back. This is the worst experience I've ever had. Put me through to your manager. I'm going to plaster this all over social media.

I assure you, there's no need for a manager, I am fully authorized to resolve this for you right now. Since it's a sizing issue and you're unfortunately outside our 10-day policy for apparel, we have two simple options. We can cannot offer a refund, or I can set up an immediate exchange for a larger size. Which would you prefer?
Wait, really? You'll just exchange it?

Of course. We want to make sure you have gear that fits you perfectly. If you'd like the exchange, I can place the order for the new size right now, at no cost to you. I'll also email you a prepaid shipping label to send back the jersey that's too tight.
Oh. Uh, fine. Do the exchange then. I want a Large.

Excellent. I've just processed the exchange for a ProFit Jersey in size Large. You should receive an email confirmation and the return label within the next five minutes. The new item will ship out within one business day.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
